# compare.py blind spots, demonstrated

Generated by `tests/conformance/tooling/blindspots.py`: each row mutates one oracle golden run and compares
the mutant with the unmutated run. `compare.py` = its verdict (`match` means the ratchet cannot see the
change); `compare_strict.py` = the strict checks that differ.

| mutation | golden run | compare.py | compare_strict.py |
|---|---|---|---|
| line/area/wedge geometry: every coordinate of the first <path d> moved 20 units | `p1-09-revenue-by-business-unit--truncated` | report-only | attributes |
| figure size: root width/viewBox changed from the original's | `gen-01-days-in-each-month` | report-only | figure |
| mark symbol: a dot drawn with another symbol (use href) | `p1-10-transactions-per-month--sparse` | report-only | attributes |
| z-order: gridlines drawn over the marks | `gen-01-days-in-each-month` | report-only | order |
| text anchor: a label anchored at its other end | `p1-01-headcount-by-region--over-pruned` | report-only | attributes, text-place |
| inline colour: a texture pattern's ink changed | `p2-50-deviation-from-budget--bw` | report-only | paint |
| swapped labels: two category names exchanged (same multiset) | `p1-01-headcount-by-region--over-pruned` | report-only | text-place |
| sub-tolerance drift: every bar moved 0.45 units | `gen-01-days-in-each-month` | report-only | attributes |
| unit-bearing geometry: a bar width written as '12pt' (unparseable, skipped) | `gen-01-days-in-each-month` | report-only | attributes |
| <title> text changed | `gen-01-days-in-each-month` | report-only | title |
| report: scale labels in reverse order (summary lists are sorted before comparing) | `gen-01-days-in-each-month` | report-diff | summary-order |
| report: a finding's message and supply text changed (prose not compared, by design) | `gen-01-days-in-each-month` | match | not caught |
| report: one finding's path moved to another severity (paths compared as a set) | `gen-01-days-in-each-month` | report-diff | findings-with-paths |
